sections.description: Deep expertise in Oklahoma City's key industry verticals.

blocks.heading: Oil and Gas (Devon Energy and Continental Resources)
paragraphs: Oklahoma City is one of the US's most significant oil and gas headquarters cities:

Devon Energy (OKC HQ): One of the US's largest independent oil and gas companies, focused on US shale basins (Permian, Delaware, Anadarko, Eagle Ford): Production optimization ML from Permian and Anadarko Basin well telemetry — predicting artificial lift efficiency, water cut trends, and gas-oil ratio evolution for Devon's large operated well portfolio. Completions analytics: ML for hydraulic fracturing design optimization — predicting which completion parameters (stage spacing, proppant loading, fluid volume) maximize well productivity for Oklahoma's Anadarko Basin formations. Lease operating expense optimization: ML for reducing lifting costs across Devon's large operated well portfolio.

Continental Resources (OKC HQ): Harold Hamm's shale oil company and a major North Dakota Bakken operator: Bakken shale reservoir analytics for Continental's large North Dakota position. Field operations scheduling and route optimization for Continental's large field operations teams.
Cost: $55,000–$155,000 | Timeline: 12–24 weeks | Oil field data formats

blocks.heading: Healthcare
paragraphs: OU Health (University of Oklahoma Health system, academic medical center), Mercy Health (large OKC presence), and INTEGRIS Health (OKC HQ, Oklahoma's largest health system):
HIPAA-compliant clinical AI for Oklahoma's major health systems.
Oklahoma Medicaid (SoonerCare) population health analytics for managed care organizations serving Oklahoma's large Medicaid population.
Rural health analytics for OU Health's large rural Oklahoma patient community.
Cost: $45,000–$125,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks | HIPAA, Oklahoma OHCA

blocks.heading: Tribal Enterprise and Gaming
paragraphs: Oklahoma has the US's second-largest Native American population — 39 federally recognized tribes operate gaming and enterprise businesses:
Casino gaming analytics for Oklahoma's large tribal gaming community — table game analytics, slot machine optimization, player tracking, and gaming compliance.
Tribal enterprise operations: hospitality analytics, workforce management, and supply chain AI for the tribes operating large hotel and entertainment complexes.
Economic development analytics for tribal economic development programs.
Cost: $30,000–$90,000 | Timeline: 8–20 weeks | NIGC, tribal sovereignty context

blocks.heading: Agriculture (Oklahoma's Large Farm Economy)
paragraphs: Oklahoma is a major wheat, cattle, and cotton producer — the state's large agricultural economy creates precision agriculture AI demand:
Winter wheat yield prediction for Oklahoma's dominant crop.
Cattle operations analytics for Oklahoma's large beef cattle industry.
Drought risk prediction and irrigation management for Oklahoma's water-scarce agricultural regions.
Cost: $25,000–$80,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks

paragraphs: The Midtown Oklahoma City technology district — anchored by the University of Oklahoma's Health Sciences Center and the significant investment from oil and gas companies in technology modernization — has become a productive technology innovation geography for a city of Oklahoma City's size.

blocks.heading: Energy companies' AI investment acceleration
paragraphs: Devon Energy and Continental Resources have both significantly accelerated their data science and AI investment programs following the shale revolution's shift to data-driven production optimization. The 'data company that produces oil' framing has driven investment in subsurface analytics, production forecasting, and field operations AI that has created a local petroleum data science talent community.

paragraphs: Oklahoma's 39 federally recognized tribes collectively manage significant commercial and economic development operations — the Chickasaw Nation's WinStar World Casino, the Cherokee Nation's diverse business portfolio, and the Osage Nation's oil and gas operations create tribal enterprise AI demand that represents a significant and growing market.
